name: instagram_send_dm
description: SENDS A REAL MESSAGE TO A REAL PERSON: send a text direct message. Returns { recipient_id, message_id }. Three rules decide whether it is allowed at all: the account may only message someone who messaged it first — get their IGSID from instagram_get_message's `from.id`, or from instagram_list_conversations; the reply window is 24 hours from their last message, and after that the API answers error code 10, subcode 2534022, which is the rule working rather than a fault, and is not something to retry; and this machine refuses any recipient a human has not allowed with `degen-portal instagram allow <igsid>`. A sent DM cannot be unsent through the API. If this fails, read the error and stop — calling again is how the same person is messaged twice.

recipient_id.description: The Instagram-scoped id (IGSID) of the person, from instagram_get_message's `from.id` or instagram_list_conversations. Not a username.

text.description: The message, UTF-8, 1000 bytes or less. Links are allowed and render as links.
